a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost certainly fails for both of us. So I intend to take from the reserve in round 1 rather than operate. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we survive past round 1, I'll operate every round after that so you can get your 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement and leaves you short, and I'm sorry. If we get past this round I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
